title: Product of Array Except Self

monster.name: Multiplicative Gorgon
monster.title: Drainer of Single Factors
monster.defeatQuote: Prefix and suffix products dissolved my immunity!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is equal to the product of all the elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`. Do it in O(n) without division.
solutionCode:
def productExceptSelf(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    n = len(nums)
    res = [1] * n
    p = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = p
        p *= nums[i]
    s = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= s
        s *= nums[i]
    return res

def productExceptSelf(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    n = len(nums)
    res = [1] * n
    p = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = p
        p *= nums[i]
    s = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
